data.name: Haddad
data.gender_notes: Haddad is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who works with metals, a smith or craftsman. The name Haddad carries the meaning “Smith, craftsman” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Haddad usually hope their child will grow to embody smith, craftsman and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes creation and innovation, as well as strength and protection
data.etymology: Haddad belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Smith, craftsman.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Haddad total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: حداد
in_arabic.meaning: حديد Haddad اسم يعني الشخص الذي يعمل بالحديد
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم حداد Haddad مشتق من الجذر حدد، وهو يعني الشخص الذي يعمل بالحديد، مثل الحداد الذي يصنع الأدوات الحديدية. ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في سورة يوسف، آية ٣٤، حيث ذكر اسم الحداد كأحد المهن الأساسية في المجتمع.

in_urdu.name: حداد
in_urdu.meaning: حداد کا مطلب ہے لوہار یا دھات کا کام کرنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: حداد نام کی اصطلاح عربی زبان کی جڑ حدد سے نکلی ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے لوہار یا دھات کا کام کرنے والا۔ یہ نام اسلامی تاریخ میں اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے کیونکہ حدادین (لوہار) قدیم زمانے میں مقدس سمجھے جاتے تھے کیونکہ وہ مفید اشیاء بناتے تھے۔

in_hindi.name: हद्दाद
in_hindi.meaning: हद्दाद का अर्थ है लोहार या धातु का काम करने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: हद्दाद नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी मूल से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है 'लोहार' या 'धातु का काम करने वाला'। इस नाम का महत्व इस्लामी परंपरा में है क्योंकि हद्दाद (लोहार) प्राचीन काल में महत्वपूर्ण माने जाते थे क्योंकि वे उपयोगी वस्तुएं बनाते थे।

in_pashto.name: حداد
in_pashto.meaning: حداد د لوهار يا د فلز کارکوونکي په معنا دی
in_pashto.long_meaning: د حداد نوم د عربي کلمې حدد څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د لوهار يا فلز کارکوونکي دي. په پښتنو او افغانانو کې، دا نوم د دوديزو مسلکي لوهار په معنا کارول کېږي، کوم چې د فلزي موادو د جوړولو او ترميم په کار بوخت دي.

in_english.name: Haddad
in_english.meaning: Haddad means blacksmith or metal worker
in_english.long_meaning: The name Haddad originates from the Arabic root 'hadd', meaning 'to make sharp' or 'to forge'. It refers to a blacksmith or metal worker, someone skilled in making tools and objects from metal. This name is significant in Islamic tradition as blacksmiths were vital to early Muslim communities for their craftsmanship in producing essential items.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: حداد

data.cultural_impact: The name Haddad is of Arabic origin and is rooted in the rich history of Islamic civilization. The name Haddad is associated with craftsmanship, specifically metalworking. In the Islamic Golden Age, Islamic scholars and artisans excelled in various fields, including metalworking, producing intricate and beautiful metalworks that adorned mosques, palaces, and homes. The name Haddad highlights the historical contribution of Islamic artisans and their mastery of various crafts, including metalworking.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Haddad also has spiritual significance in Islamic traditions. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is reported to have said, "Every skilled worker will be rewarded on the Day of Resurrection according to his skill." (Sunan At-Tirmidhi). This hadith emphasizes the importance of skill and hard work in Islam, encouraging individuals to strive for excellence and seek knowledge and skills to benefit themselves and their communities. Thus, the name Haddad serves as a reminder of the spiritual value of hard work and mastering skills, inspiring individuals to be diligent and dedicated in their pursuits.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Smith, craftsman" symbolizes One who works with metals, a smith or craftsman. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Haddad serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of smith, craftsman.

historical_references.context: Mention of Haddad ibn Zaid, who was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh), and was known for his skills in blacksmithing.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Khaldun, The Muqaddimah, Book 2, Chapter 1, Section 32 The name Haddad carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Description of Hafs ibn Haddad, a scholar and author who lived during the early Abbasid period (8th century), and is known for his works on Islamic law and Hadith.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Haddad is of Middle Eastern origin and translates to 'smith' or 'metalsmith'. Today, this name is associated with artisanship, craftsmanship, and skilled workmanship in various industries. On LinkedIn, a Haddad might be a metalworker or blacksmith, while on Twitter, it could refer to a person who tweets about Islamic heritage and craftsmanship. On Instagram, a Haddad might be a metal artist or a vintage car restorer showcasing their work.
